title: The Glowing Minds of Dennis de Guim
description: A story of love and friendship between a human, Jack, and a Botricon ship’s chief pleasure port, who join together in a quest for courage, wisdom and, above all, dignity.
quote: Mourn not my passing, for we Botricons do not fear death.
parent: Man to Man With Dean Learner
altHero: Glynn Nimron, leaning in the grass, next to Jack; the sky is an orange red
alt1: Nimron’s chin is expelling liquid into a glass
alt4: Jack looks up at the heavens
